verdicts.evidence: In the sidebar, "Billing" (third item) has a light blue tint and bold blue text, but the content area is headed "Account settings" and shows four cards, one of which is Billing.
The sidebar lists Profile, Notifications, Billing, Members, Integrations and Security; the cards are Profile, Notifications, Billing and Sessions, so Sessions has no sidebar item.
The Billing card reads "Your plan renews on 1 March. The invoice goes to the address on file." and gives no amount, plan name, year or actual address.
